name: Settings
description: One row: what the shop website shows (store name, tagline, currency, contact, language, ship-to countries) and what the daily shop check uses (required certificates, expiry warning, standing check rules). The website reads it on every refresh, so a change here shows on the live site within about a minute, without a redeploy.

agentPrompts.label: What does my shop show right now?
agentPrompts.body: Read the `busa-shop` skill in this folder, then tell me the store name, tagline, currency, contact email, language and ship-to countries on record, whether the demo notice is still on, and which Products table the shop is reading.

agentPrompts.label: Change the store name, tagline or contact
agentPrompts.body: Read the `busa-shop` skill in this folder, then update the store name, tagline, contact email, about text or shipping note I give you on the one Settings row. Tell me it shows on the live site within about a minute, with no redeploy.

agentPrompts.label: Get the shop ready to go live
agentPrompts.body: Read the `busa-shop` skill in this folder and follow "Open the shop": check the Products table it reads, the currency, contact email, ship-to countries and demo notice, and tell me exactly what I still have to do before I click Go live.
